subject: general
question: The 'Hunar Haat' exhibition was organised in the Kota district of Rajasthan from 27 February to 7 March 2021 under the USTTAD scheme of the ________.

options.text: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

solution:
The correct answer is__ **Ministry of Minority of Affairs.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Minority of Affairs**

 
 
• The Indian government's Ministry of Minority Affairs was established on **January 29, 2006**, after the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment was split up.
 
• It is the **highest body** for the regulatory and development programs run by the **central government** in India for minority religious and linguistic communities.
 
• These communities include** Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Zoroastrians (Parsis), and Jains**, all of whom were listed as minority religious communities in **The Gazette of India** in accordance with Section 2(c) of the **National Commission for Minorities Act, 1992.**
 
• On **September 4, 2017**, **Mukhtar Abbas Naqvi **became the cabinet minister for Minority Affairs. When **Najma Heptulla** was the cabinet minister, he was the Minister of State for Minority Affairs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Finance**

 
 
• **​**The Indian government's Ministry of Finance is responsible for the **country's economy** and serves as the country's Treasury.
 
• Taxation, financial regulations, financial institutions, capital markets, central and state finances, and the Union Budget are just a few of the topics it addresses.
 
• The** Indian Revenue Service**, the **Indian Audit and Accounts Service**, the **Indian Economic Service**, and the **Indian Civil Accounts Service** are the four central civil services that are overseen by the Ministry of Finance.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Home Affairs**
 
 
• **​**A ministry of the Indian government is known as the Ministry of Home Affairs, or simply the** Home Ministry.**
 
• It is primarily accountable for maintaining **domestic policy and internal security** as India's interior ministry. **Amit Shah**, Union Minister of Home Affairs, is in charge of the Home Ministry.
 
• The cadre controlling authority for the **Indian Police Service (IPS), DANIPS, and DANICS** is also the Home Ministry.
 
• The ministry's Police-I Division is in charge of cadre control for the Indian Police Service; DANIPS' administrative division, on the other hand, is the UT Division.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship**
 
 
• **​**India's Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship was established on **November 9, 2014**, to oversee the nation's entire skill development program.
 
• On **April 16, 2015, the Ministry of Labour and Employment** handed over responsibility for industrial training, apprenticeships, and other skill development activities to this newly formed ministry.
 
• It aims to close the gap between the demand for** skilled workers and the supply**, developing new skills and creative thinking for both existing jobs and future ones.
